stories.title: Define Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for board certification data including certification name, issuing board, status (verified/unverified/unknown), source (NPI), and normalization rules. Ensure compatibility with provider_detail_service output.

stories.title: Implement Board Certification Extraction and Verification Logic
stories.description: Extract credential fields from NPI registry response and map them to known board certifications using normalization rules. Implement verification classification logic (e.g., recognized board vs free-text credential).

stories.title: Expose Board Certification Data via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate board certification signals into provider detail response and expose through evaluate_care_facade for downstream consumption by chat UI and evaluation flows.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Board Certification Verification
stories.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI lookup through facade response, including verified/unverified/unknown scenarios.

stories.title: Handle Missing, Ambiguous, and Non-Standard Credential Data
stories.description: Implement explicit handling for edge cases in NPI credential data including missing credentials, ambiguous abbreviations, and non-standard free-text entries. Add flags for unverifiable certifications and ensure downstream consumers receive clear status indicators (e.g., verified, unverified, unknown).
